9.critic_justification: AndroidManifest.xml line 6 declares android.permission.USE_EXACT_ALARM. Under Google Play Policy, USE_EXACT_ALARM is restricted to apps whose primary core function is an alarm clock, timer, or calendar app with event reminders. As a task and routine planner, LifePlanner does not qualify for USE_EXACT_ALARM and must rely exclusively on SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM.
